title: Pitch Deck Slide Design Vibe
description: Thiết kế visual layout cho một slide thuyết trình hoặc pitch deck theo phong cách hiện đại.
author: Tôi Là Tùng
template: A professional presentation slide design for [Slide Theme, e.g., Market Size opportunity]. Aspect ratio 16:9. Minimalist dark mode design. Left half features large, bold, clean sans-serif typography showing the headline [Headline, e.g., $150B Market Opportunity]. Right half features a clean, high-contrast 3D glassmorphic bar chart visualizing the growth trends. Style: Elegant, premium, tech-focused, cinematic look. Color palette: Matte black background (#121214), glowing neon cyan (#06B6D4) and soft grey. Clean lines, generous whitespace, zero clutter, professional layout, 8K resolution.
